componentSet.name: Card
componentSet.description:
Card — THE CONTAINER PRIMITIVE, one card, everything else is assembly (EDS 1.0's philosophy, and the team's own architecture: their showcase cards all compose a bare _Card Container). Neutral surface with a subtle outline; interactivity is the MARKUP's fact, not a prop — an <a> or <button> card affords, a <div> card sits still. Plain (uncorrected) inset: no text to compensate for.

Generated from eds.card v0.2.0 — edit the contract, not this component.
